[red bold]-- TASK ERROR -- main.volt:3[/red bold]

Function `go` contains a yield (sleep/every/on) and calls itself recursively. Recursive yielding functions cannot be inlined into protothreads.

 [dim]2 |[/dim] hardware { pin led: Output = 4 }
 [dim]3 |[/dim] func go() {
 [dim]  |[/dim] [red]     ^^[/red]

[cyan]Hint: Rewrite as a while loop instead of recursion.[/cyan]


[yellow bold]-- TASK WARNING -- main.volt:7[/yellow bold]

 [dim]7 |[/dim] task t { go() }
